questions.question: A dealer marks his goods 10% above the cost price and allows 10% discount. What is his percentage gain or loss?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A dealer marks his goods 10% above the cost price and allows 10% discount.

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = Marked Price (MP) - Discount

Marked Price (MP) = Cost Price (CP) × (1 + Markup Percentage)

Discount = MP × Discount Percentage

Gain or Loss Percentage = ((SP - CP) / CP) × 100

**Calculation:**

Let Cost Price (CP) = 100

Marked Price (MP) = CP × (1 + 10%)

⇒ MP = 100 × 1.1

⇒ MP = 110

Discount = MP × 10%

⇒ Discount = 110 × 0.1

⇒ Discount = 11

Selling Price (SP) = MP - Discount

⇒ SP = 110 - 11

⇒ SP = 99

Gain or Loss Percentage = ((SP - CP) / CP) × 100

⇒ Gain or Loss Percentage = ((99 - 100) / 100) × 100

⇒ Gain or Loss Percentage = (-1 / 100) × 100

⇒ Gain or Loss Percentage = -1%

**The dealer has a 1% loss.**

questions.question: Who among the following has the power to grant pardons under Article 161 of the Constitution of India?

questions.question: Identify the series that is different from the rest.
If 24 men can complete a piece of work in 15 days working 8 h per day, then how many men will be required to complete the same work in 10 days working 6 h per day?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Number of men = 24

Number of days = 15

Working hours per day = 8

Number of days to complete the work = 10

Working hours per day = 6

**Formula Used:**

Work done = Number of men × Number of days × Working hours per day

Number of men required = Work done / (Number of days × Working hours per day)

**Calculation:**

Work done by 24 men in 15 days working 8 hours per day:

Work = 24 × 15 × 8

Work = 2880

Number of men required to complete the same work in 10 days working 6 hours per day:

Let the number of men required be M

Work = M × 10 × 6

2880 = M × 10 × 6

⇒ 2880 = 60M

⇒ M = 2880 / 60

⇒ M = 48

**The number of men required is 48.**

__
 
• The 'Bretton Woods Twins' refers to the **International Monetary Fund (IMF) and the World Bank**.
 
• Both institutions were established in **1944** during the United Nations Monetary and Financial Conference, commonly known as the Bretton Woods Conference.
 
• The IMF aims to foster global monetary cooperation, secure financial stability, facilitate international trade, promote high employment and sustainable economic growth, and reduce poverty.
 
• The World Bank provides financial and technical assistance to developing countries for development projects (e.g., bridges, roads, schools, etc.) that are expected to improve the economic prospects and quality of life for people in those countries.

• Delegates from 44 Allied nations attended the conference to regulate the international monetary and financial order after the conclusion of World War II.
 
• The conference led to the establishment of a system of fixed exchange rates and the creation of the Bretton Woods institutions to oversee the international monetary system.
 
• The IMF and World Bank have since played a crucial role in the global economy, providing financial assistance and policy advice to countries around the world.

questions.question: If the cost price of six items is equal to the selling price of seven items, then what will be the percentage profit or loss?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost price of six items = Selling price of seven items

**Formula Used:**

Profit or Loss Percentage = ((Selling Price - Cost Price))/(Cost Price) × 100

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price of one item be C.

Cost price of six items = 6C.

Let the selling price of one item be S.

Selling price of seven items = 7S.

According to the given condition:

6C = 7S

⇒ S = (6C)/(7)

Profit or Loss = Selling Price - Cost Price

Profit or Loss for one item = S - C

⇒ Profit or Loss = (6C)/(7) - C

⇒ Profit or Loss = (6C - 7C)/(7)

⇒ Profit or Loss = (-C)/(7)

Since the value is negative, it indicates a loss.

Loss Percentage = ((-C/7))/(C) × 100

⇒ Loss Percentage = (1)/(7) × 100

⇒ Loss Percentage = 14.28%

**The correct answer is option 1: 14.28% loss.**

Prime factorization:

12 = 2² × 3

18 = 2 × 3²

questions.question: The equation whose roots are -2 and 3 is:

**Formula used:**

The general form of a quadratic equation with roots α and β is:

x² - (α + β)x + αβ = 0

Where α and β are the roots of the equation.

**Calculation:**

Given roots: α = -2 and β = 3

Sum of the roots (α + β) = -2 + 3 = 1

Product of the roots (αβ) = -2 × 3 = -6

Therefore, the equation is:

x² - (α + β)x + αβ = 0

⇒ x² - 1x - 6 = 0

**∴ The required equation is x² - x - 6 = 0.**

questions.question: There are two numbers with the difference of 14 between them and difference of their squares is 56. What are those numbers?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

There are two numbers with the difference of 14 between them and the difference of their squares is 56.

**Formula used:**

 x² - y² = (x + y)(x - y).

**Calculation:**

Let the two numbers be x and y.

So, x - y = 14 and x2 - y2 = 56.

Using the formula:

x² - y² = (x + y)(x - y)

⇒ 56 = (x + y) × 14

⇒ x + y = 56 / 14 ⇒ x + y = 4 ... (1)

⇒ x - y = 14.... (2)

Adding both equations:

(x - y) + (x + y) = 14 + 4

⇒ 2x = 18

⇒ x = 9

Substituting x = 9 in Equation (1): x + y = 4 ⇒ y = -5

**The two numbers are 9 and -5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

**Given: **There are two numbers with the difference of 14. Let the two numbers be x and y. So, x - y = 14.

By, putting the option we can also check the value which fit in the given equation.

Option 1, i.e. x = 9 and y = -5, 

⇒ x - y = 9 - (-5) = 14. 

**Hence Option (1) is the correct answer.**
